messages:
ashley: Heads-up — scheduling a dedicated GPU slice swap tonight at 21:30 UTC for the `cobalt` pool. Plan: bump minscale 2 -> 4 and apply new autoscale policy (latency target 220ms). I'll perform the deploy and initial smoke. Rolling window 21:30-22:00 UTC. Reply with ownership/standby.

sam: On standby for monitoring + rollback. Happy to take traces and error budget checks.

kai: Quick q — is this just a config/policy change or are we touching allocator/agent binaries?

ashley: Config + autoscale policy only. No allocator binary changes. Config path: `/deploys/dedicated/pools/cobalt/2026-03-17/policy.yaml`.

priya: I'll own smoke verification post-deploy. I'll run the load script and validate p50/p95 and correctness for a selected prompt set.

ashley: Smoke commands (local):
```
# small warm/cold smoke, ~1k requests
./tools/loadtest --pool cobalt --conns 50 --n 1000 --endpoint /v1/generate --template smoke_prompts.json
```
Acceptance: median <150ms, p95 <400ms. If p95 > 700ms or error rate > 0.5% — trigger rollback.

deploy-bot: deploy queued by ashley for 2026-03-17T21:30:00Z. CID: dbc-20260317-92.

liam: Any datastore or infra changes I should be aware of? metrics TTLs?

ashley: No datastore changes. Metrics/retention unchanged. I'll run cache priming after the swap (top-10 prefixes).

priya: Will post smoke results here (latency histogram + sample responses). If anything looks off I will call for rollback within 10m.

sam: Quick CR ping — @priya can you glance at my autoscale test tweak PR before deploy? https://git.internal/r/redwood/pulls/4321

kai: Rollback plan: revert to previous policy with:
```
redwoodctl capacity apply --pool cobalt --file policy.v20260316.yaml
```
Estimated rollback to stable: ~3-5min to ramp and ~5-7min for observability to converge.

oncall-bot: Oncall assigned: sam (21:00-23:00 UTC). Pager rules active.

ashley: Thanks — unless objections I'll proceed at 21:30. Final sanity checklist: 1) PR merged, 2) smoke owner ready, 3) oncall assigned, 4) rollback command tested.

kai: All good from infra side.

priya: PR ok, I'm ready. Posting smoke results within 10m of completion.

sam: Monitoring ready. Please ping in-thread when deploy starts. Good luck. :thumbsup:
